title: movie-planner import row
description: One viewing, as `movie-planner import` accepts it from `movies.json` (an array of these) or `movies.csv` (these same field names as the header row, every value plain CSV text - so a JSON-typed field like release_year appears as a numeral-only string there instead of a JSON number, and an absent value is an empty cell rather than a missing key). These are movie-planner's own canonical field names - movie-planner-web's import/export schema (https://github.com/alrayyes/movie-planner-web/blob/main/public/schemas/movie-viewings.schema.json) uses the same ones, plus a few fields of its own for full-fidelity round-tripping.

release_year.description: A JSON number in movies.json; a digit-only string in movies.csv.
